definition_zh: 有效的；正当的；有根据的；合法的
definition_en: able to be legally used, based on sound reasoning, or accepted as true
core_image: 检票闸机亮起绿灯，车票被放行
scene: 车站闸机前，他把票贴上去，绿灯亮起，挡板轻轻一响才打开。Your ticket is valid for two hours after you buy it.
sceneCN: 这里 valid 是「有效的」（第 1 个义项：在规则上能用）；句意为车票购买后两小时内有效。闸机亮起绿灯的画面，正是这个词的核心。

pos.zh: 有效的；合法的
有根据的；站得住脚的

derivatives.zh: 加 -ity 构成名词，义为「有效性；合法性」
加 -ate 构成动词，义为「使有效；验证」
加否定前缀 in-，义为「无效的」
加 -ation 构成名词，义为「验证；确认」

senses.title: Legally or officially acceptable
senses.definition: accepted by law or by rules for a certain period
senses.definitionCN: 被法律或规则认可，并在一定期限内可用
senses.example: This passport is valid for another three years.
senses.exampleCN: 这本护照还有三年有效期。
senses.why: The Latin adjective means strong; a paper that is strong by the rules is one the gate must let through.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁形容词本义是「强的」；一份按规矩站得住的证件，就是闸机必须放行的证件。

senses.title: Based on sound reasoning
senses.definition: of an argument or point, sound and hard to attack
senses.definitionCN: 形容论点扎实、难以反驳
senses.example: Her objection was valid and changed the design.
senses.exampleCN: 她的反对意见有道理，设计因此改了。
senses.why: An argument that stands up to attack is strong in the same sense, so the word moves from papers to reasons.
senses.whyCN: 经得住反驳的论证同样「强」，于是词义从证件挪到了理由上。

senses.title: Accepted as true after checking
senses.definition: of a result or method, confirmed as sound by tests
senses.definitionCN: 形容结果或方法经过检验而被确认可靠
senses.example: The experiment was repeated and the result remained valid.
senses.exampleCN: 实验被重复了一次，结果依然成立。
senses.why: What survives a test is strong in the same root sense, so the word moves from gates and courts into the lab.
senses.whyCN: 经得住反复检验的东西同样「强」，于是词义又从闸机和法庭走进了实验室。

senses.title: A good and acceptable reason
senses.definition: of a reason or excuse, good enough to be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 形容理由或借口足以被人接受
senses.example: He had a valid reason for missing the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他缺席会议有正当理由。
senses.why: A reason that holds up when others look at it works like a valid paper: it passes, so it must be accepted.
senses.whyCN: 理由经人一看仍站得住，就同一份有效的文书一样能过关，因而必须被接受。

intro.en: A Latin adjective of strength, borrowed whole, whose root also gives value and valour.
intro.cn: 一个整体借入的、表示「强」的拉丁形容词，其词根也给出 value 与 valour。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong or to be worth, and validus meant strong and effective.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、有价值」，validus 意为「强壮的、有效的」。

items.en: Legal writers used validus of wills and contracts that had full force.
items.cn: 法律作者用 validus 来形容具有完全效力的遗嘱与契约。

items.en: English adopts the word in the sixteenth century from Latin legal use.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪从拉丁法律用语中采用这个词。

items.en: The sense spreads from documents to arguments and reasons that hold up.
items.cn: 词义从文书扩展到经得住推敲的论证与理由。

items.en: Validity, validate, and invalid complete the modern family.
items.cn: validity、validate 与 invalid 补全了现代词族。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the val- family of strength and worth, and the near-meaning group sets effective against void.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「强、值」的 val- 词族，近义组把有效与作废相对照。

entries.definition: the state of being valid
entries.definitionCN: 有效性

entries.definition: to prove or make valid
entries.definitionCN: 验证；使生效

entries.definition: worth or importance
entries.definitionCN: 价值

entries.definition: low land between hills, only the opening is close, the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 山谷；只是词头相近，词源不同

entries.definition: working as intended
entries.definitionCN: 有效的

entries.definition: allowed by law or fairness
entries.definitionCN: 合法的；正当的

entries.definition: well based and reliable
entries.definitionCN: 合理的；可靠的

entries.definition: having no legal force
entries.definitionCN: 无效的；作废的

normalIntro.en: Hold the root idea of strength: what is valid stands up, in law, in argument, or under test.
normalIntro.cn: 记住「强」这个根义：valid 的东西站得住，无论在法律上、论证里还是检验中。

normal.en: A ticket is valid for a period, so the preposition is for.
normal.cn: 车票的有效期用 for 表示。

normal.en: The negative is invalid, made with in-.
normal.cn: 否定形式是 invalid，用 in- 构成。

normal.en: Validate is what a system does to the password you type.
normal.cn: validate 就是系统对你输入的密码所做的事。

normal.en: A valid point in a meeting is an argument that holds.
normal.cn: 会上的 a valid point 指站得住的论点。

normal.en: Value and valid share one root: strength and worth.
normal.cn: value 与 valid 同根：强与值。

abstract.en: Picture a gate lamp turning green as a ticket is read.
abstract.cn: 想象读票时闸机灯变绿。

abstract.en: See a stamp with a date that has just run out.
abstract.cn: 看一枚日期刚过的印章。

abstract.en: Hear a quiet objection that no one in the room can answer.
abstract.cn: 听一句无人能答复的低声反对。

examples.en: The pass is valid on all city buses until midnight.
examples.cn: 这张通行证在午夜前可用于所有市内公交。

examples.en: She raised a valid point about the cost of the plan.
examples.cn: 她就计划成本提出了一个站得住脚的意见。

examples.en: The results were checked twice and are still valid.
examples.cn: 结果核验了两次，依然成立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威力的」——有威力的东西自然有效力。

root: 拉丁语 valere（强壮、有价值）的形容词 validus（强壮的、有效的），进入英语为 valid

sensesIntro.en: A root of strength spreads into legal force, sound reasoning, tested results, and reasons good enough to be accepted.
sensesIntro.cn: 「强」这个词根延伸到法律效力、论证扎实、经检验的结果以及够格的正当理由。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gate lamp turning green for a ticket.
core.cn: 核心意象：闸机为一张票亮起绿灯。

branches.en: The legal branch: the rule still lets it pass.
branches.cn: 法律分支：规则仍然允许通过。

branches.en: The argument branch: it holds up under attack.
branches.cn: 论证分支：经受得住反驳。

branches.en: The test branch: it survives a repeat check.
branches.cn: 检验分支：重复检验后仍然成立。

branches.en: The reason branch: good enough to be accepted.
branches.cn: 理由分支：够格被人接受。

branches.en: The force branch: valid always means it can be relied on.
branches.cn: 效力分支：有效总意味着可以依靠。

intro.en: A Latin adjective of strength with an adjective ending, closely tied to value and valour.
intro.cn: 一个表示「强」的拉丁形容词加形容词词尾，与 value、valour 紧密相关。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere meant to be strong or to be worth, and validus meant strong; value and valour belong to the same family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere 意为「强壮、有价值」，validus 意为「强壮的」；value 与 valour 同属这一词族。

items.example: The root val- joins strength with worth.
items.exampleCN: 词根 val- 把强壮与价值连在一起。

items.example: Validate means to make or prove valid.
items.exampleCN: validate 意为使有效或加以证实。

items.example: Valour shares the root of strength.
Value keeps the worth side of the root.
items.exampleCN: value 保留了词根中「价值」的一面。

latinEntries.meaning: to be strong, to be worth

definition_zh: 验证；确认……有效；使生效；批准认可
definition_en: to prove or confirm that something is valid, true or legally effective
core_image: 窗口前，一张表格递进来，工作人员在最后一栏盖上圆形印章，纸上的内容立刻有了效力
scene: 窗口前，一张表格递进来，工作人员在最后一栏盖上圆形印章，纸上的内容立刻有了效力。Engineers validate every sensor against a known standard.
sceneCN: 这里指检验并确认某物符合标准（第 1 个义项：验证数据或器件有效）；句意为工程师用已知标准校验每一个传感器。

pos.zh: 验证；确认有效；使生效；批准

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「验证；生效；认可」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「验证者；校验器」
由该动词的过去分词转成的形容词，义为「已验证的；已生效的」
由该动词的现在分词转成的形容词，义为「起验证作用的」

senses.title: Check data against a standard
senses.definition: to test measurements or records against a known rule to show that they are sound
senses.definitionCN: 用已知规则检验测量值或记录，以证明它们可靠
senses.example: The lab validates each batch of samples before release.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室在放行之前验证每一批样品。
senses.why: The root means strong, and the verb asks whether a result can stand up to a standard.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「强、有力」，而这个动词问的是：一项结果能否在标准面前站得住。

senses.title: Confirm a claim or hypothesis
senses.definition: to give evidence that a statement or theory is correct
senses.definitionCN: 提供证据说明某项陈述或理论是正确的
senses.example: New evidence validated his earlier claim.
senses.exampleCN: 新证据证实了他先前的说法。
senses.why: A claim is valid when it holds, and the verb names the act of showing that it holds.
senses.whyCN: 主张站得住就叫有效，而这个动词命名的正是证明它站得住的动作。

senses.title: Give legal force to a document
senses.definition: of a court or official, to declare a will, contract or act legally effective
senses.definitionCN: 指法院或官员宣布遗嘱、合同或行为在法律上有效
senses.example: The judge validated the will after the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 听证之后，法官确认了遗嘱的效力。
senses.why: This is the sense where the word does not merely check but confers force; validation changes the legal status.
senses.whyCN: 在这个义项里，词不只是检查，而是授予效力；「确认有效」改变了法律地位。

senses.title: Approve a plan or decision
senses.definition: of a body with authority, to accept a proposal and allow it to proceed
senses.definitionCN: 指有权的机构接受提案并允许其推进
senses.example: The board validated the plan at its monthly meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会在月度会议上批准了该计划。
senses.why: Approval is a stamp that makes a paper count, which is the image the word carries in administration.
senses.whyCN: 批准是一枚让纸张算数的印章，这正是这个词在行政语境里携带的意象。

senses.title: Prove a ticket or identity
senses.definition: to check that a ticket, pass or document belongs to the person using it
senses.definitionCN: 检查票证或文件是否属于使用它的人
senses.example: The gate validates each ticket before the concert.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐会在入场前逐一验票。
senses.why: A ticket is valid only for one holder and one time, and the verb is the act of confirming both.
senses.whyCN: 一张票只对一位持有者和一个时间有效，而这个动词就是确认这两件事的动作。

senses.title: Check that input is acceptable
senses.definition: in computing, to test data entered by a user against the rules a system requires
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中指按系统规则检验用户输入的数据
senses.example: The app validates the form before sending it.
senses.exampleCN: 应用在发送之前会校验表单。
senses.why: Software borrowed the word because a form either meets the rule or does not, exactly like a document before a clerk.
senses.whyCN: 软件借用这个词，因为表单要么符合规则、要么不符合，正如文件到了办事员面前。

senses.title: Test a model or method
senses.definition: to show that a model, instrument or procedure produces trustworthy results
senses.definitionCN: 证明模型、仪器或程序能产生可信结果
senses.example: The team validated the model with a second data set.
senses.exampleCN: 团队用第二套数据验证了该模型。
senses.why: A model is valid when it works beyond the cases that built it, and validation is the test of that reach.
senses.whyCN: 模型能在建造它的案例之外也起作用才算有效，而验证就是对这份覆盖力的测试。

senses.title: Recognize someone's feelings
senses.definition: in psychology, to affirm that another person's emotional experience is real and understandable
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中指确认他人的情感体验是真实、可理解的
senses.example: A good listener validates what the speaker feels.
senses.exampleCN: 好的倾听者会认可说话者的感受。
senses.why: Here validity is granted to an inner state rather than to a document, and the word turns warm.
senses.whyCN: 这里被授予效力的是内心状态而不是文件，这个词也随之变暖。

senses.title: Confirm the standing of a qualification
senses.titleCN: 确认学历或资格的效力
senses.definition: of an authority, to accept a degree, licence or certificate as officially usable
senses.definitionCN: 指权威机构承认学位、执照或证书可正式使用
senses.example: The registry validates foreign qualifications case by case.
senses.exampleCN: 登记机构逐一确认海外学历的效力。
senses.why: A qualification is only useful where it is recognized, and the verb marks the boundary between holding and being able to use.
senses.whyCN: 资格只有在被承认的地方才有用，而这个动词标出「持有」与「能够使用」之间的界线。

intro.en: Validate comes from Medieval Latin validare, to make valid, from validus, strong, from valere, to be strong or be worth.
intro.cn: 这个词来自中世纪拉丁语 validare「使有效」，而 validare 出自 validus「强壮的」，其底层是 valere「有力、有价值」。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong, to be worth or to have influence, and it also gave English value and valour.
items.cn: valere 意为有力、有价值或有影响，它还给英语带来「价值」与「英勇」等词。

items.en: The adjective meant strong, sturdy or effective, and it became the everyday word for a sound argument or a sound body.
items.cn: 这个形容词意为强壮的、坚实的、有效的，后来成为形容论证可靠或身体强健的日常词。

items.en: Legal Latin formed a verb meaning to make valid or to give force to a document.
items.cn: 法律拉丁语造出一个动词，意为使有效、授予文件效力。

items.en: French carried the legal verb into administrative use before English borrowed it.
items.cn: 法语把这个法律动词带进行政用途，之后英语才借入。

items.en: English took the verb in the seventeenth century; the exact first date is uncertain, and the legal sense came first.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪取用这个动词；确切首见年代不确定，法律义最先出现。

items.en: Science and computing made it the standard verb for testing data, models and input against a rule.
items.cn: 科学与计算机使它成为按规则检验数据、模型与输入的标准动词。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like validate; the second group names neighbouring ways of confirming something.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 validate 相近；第二组是与「确认、证实」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The act of proving something valid or giving it force.
entries.definitionCN: 指证明某物有效或授予其效力的行为。

entries.definition: A person or program that checks validity.
entries.definitionCN: 指检查有效性的个人或程序。

entries.definition: Sound, legally effective or based on good reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 指可靠的、法律上有效的，或基于良好推理的。

entries.definition: The quality of being sound or legally effective.
entries.definitionCN: 指可靠或法律上有效的性质。

entries.definition: To make something void; it is built on the negative of the adjective, not on this verb.
entries.definitionCN: 指使某物失效；它建立在形容词的否定形式之上，而不是本动词之上。

entries.definition: To check whether a fact or figure is true; it asks about accuracy rather than effect.
entries.definitionCN: 指检查事实或数字是否真实；它追问准确与否，而非效力。

entries.definition: To show that something already believed is true; it adds certainty rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 指表明原本已被相信的事是真的；增加的是确定性，而非效力。

entries.definition: To state officially, often in writing, that something meets a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 指以官方方式、常以书面形式声明某物符合标准。

entries.definition: To give formal approval to a treaty or agreement, making it binding.
entries.definitionCN: 指对条约或协议给予正式批准，使其具有约束力。

entries.definition: To support a claim with evidence; it stresses the proof offered.
entries.definitionCN: 指用证据支撑主张；强调所提供的证明。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the strong root, the stamp image and the contrast with mere checking.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想利用「有力」的词根、盖章的意象，以及它与单纯检查的对比。

normal.en: The root means strong, so something valid can stand; to validate is to show that it stands.
normal.cn: 词根意为有力，所以有效的东西站得住；而「验证」就是证明它站得住。

normal.en: A round stamp on the last column is the picture: the paper does not change, its force does.
normal.cn: 最后一栏上的圆形印章就是那幅图：纸没有变，变的是它的效力。

normal.en: A ticket is validated at the gate, a model at a second data set, a feeling by a good listener.
normal.cn: 票在闸口被验证，模型在第二套数据上被验证，感受由好的倾听者来确认。

normal.en: Verify asks whether it is true; validate asks whether it counts.
normal.cn: 「核实」问的是真假，「确认有效」问的是算不算数。

normal.en: The word can be cold in a laboratory and warm in a therapist's room, because validity applies to numbers and to feelings alike.
normal.cn: 这个词在实验室里是冷的，在治疗室里是暖的，因为「有效」既能用于数字，也能用于感受。

abstract.en: Validation is the moment a private fact becomes a public one.
abstract.cn: 验证，是一个私下的事实变成公开事实的那一刻。

abstract.en: To validate is to answer the question of whether something may be relied on.
abstract.cn: 验证就是回答「某物是否可以被依靠」这个问题。

abstract.en: The word grants standing, and standing is a social gift as much as a technical result.
abstract.cn: 这个词授予的是「站得住」的地位，而地位既是技术结果，也是社会赠予。

examples.en: The survey was validated by a second team.
examples.cn: 这项调查由第二个团队作了验证。

examples.en: The court validated the agreement in March.
examples.cn: 法院在三月确认了该协议的效力。

examples.en: Please validate your parking ticket at the desk.
examples.cn: 请在服务台确认停车票。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「瓦利得特」——「瓦」片盖印，「利」上生效，「得」到批准才「特」别算数：验证、使生效

root: 拉丁语 valere「有力、有价值」→ validus「强壮的、有效的」→ 中世纪拉丁语 validare「使有效」→ 法语 valider → 英语 validate「验证；使生效；批准」；核心是「让某物在标准或权威面前站得住」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses all confer or test standing: data, a claim, a will, a plan, a ticket, an input, a model, a feeling and a qualification.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都在授予或检验「站得住」的资格：数据、主张、遗嘱、计划、票证、输入、模型、感受与学历。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round stamp coming down on the last column of a form.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚圆形印章落在表格最后一栏。

branches.en: THE DATA AND MODEL BRANCH: samples are tested and a model is tried on fresh data.
branches.cn: 数据与模型分支：样品被检验，模型在新数据上被试用。

branches.en: THE CLAIM AND FEELING BRANCH: evidence supports a statement, and a listener supports an inner state.
branches.cn: 主张与感受分支：证据支撑陈述，倾听者支撑内心状态。

branches.en: THE FORCE BRANCH: a will is given legal effect and a foreign degree is given official standing.
branches.cn: 效力分支：遗嘱被赋予法律效力，海外学位被赋予官方地位。

branches.en: THE APPROVAL BRANCH: a board lets a plan proceed.
branches.cn: 批准分支：董事会允许计划推进。

branches.en: THE IDENTITY AND INPUT BRANCH: a gate checks a ticket and an app checks a form.
branches.cn: 身份与输入分支：闸口检查票证，应用检查表单。

intro.en: Validate is a Latin verb of making strong, and English built a full noun and agent family on it.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示「使强、使有效」的拉丁动词，英语在它之上建起完整的名词与施动者家族。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies valere, validus and the medieval verb validare; English adds its own endings for noun, agent and adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供 valere、validus 与中世纪动词 validare；英语加上自己的名词、施动者与形容词词尾。

items.example: It turns the adjective of strength into a verb of making valid.
items.exampleCN: 它把表示「强」的形容词变成「使有效」的动词。

items.example: The verb is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整族词的源头。

items.example: The adjective supplies the idea of standing firm.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词提供「站得稳」的意思。

items.example: It forms the noun for the act of confirming validity.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「确认有效」这一行为的名词。

items.example: It names the person or program that checks validity.
items.exampleCN: 它命名检查有效性的个人或程序。

items.example: It forms the noun for the quality of being valid.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「有效」性质的名词。

items.example: It reverses the adjective to form the opposite verb.
items.exampleCN: 它翻转形容词，构成反义动词。

items.structure: English adjective from French valide, from Latin validus
items.example: The adjective is the base the verb is built on.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是该动词赖以构成的词基。

latinEntries.structure: valido, validavi, validatum (verb, first conjugation, medieval Latin)

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「验证；生效；认可」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「验证者；校验器」
由该动词的过去分词转成的形容词，义为「已验证的；已生效的」
由该动词的现在分词转成的形容词，义为「起验证作用的」

definition_zh: 有价值的；宝贵的；贵重的；值钱的
definition_en: worth a great deal of money, or of great help and importance
core_image: 老木箱底层用绒布包着的一枚旧戒指
scene: 阁楼上翻出一只旧木箱，最底层用绒布包着一枚戒指，祖母的名字刻在里面。The ring is small but valuable.
sceneCN: 这里 valuable 是「贵重的、值钱的」（第 1 个义项：值很多钱）；句意为那枚戒指虽小却很贵重。绒布里的旧戒指，正是这个词的核心。

pos.zh: 有价值的；宝贵的
值钱的；贵重的
贵重物品

collocations.zh: 把贵重物品放在保险箱里

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀的名词，义为「价值」
加否定前缀 in-，义为「无价的；极宝贵的」
同根名词，义为「估价；评价」
换成 -less，义为「毫无价值的」

senses.title: Worth a lot of money
senses.definition: worth a large amount of money if sold
senses.definitionCN: 如果卖掉能值很多钱
senses.example: The necklace is valuable and should be kept in a safe.
senses.exampleCN: 这条项链很贵，应该放进保险箱。
senses.why: The suffix -able adds can be to the noun for worth, so the word first means able to be sold for a lot.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -able 给「价值」加上「可以」之义，于是这个词首先表示「能卖出大价钱的」。

senses.title: Of great help or importance
senses.definition: of great use or importance to someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某人很有用或很重要
senses.example: Her advice was valuable in the first weeks of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 刚入职的头几周，她的建议很宝贵。
senses.why: What can be counted as worth spreads from coins to help, since good advice is worth as much as money.
senses.whyCN: 能被算作「值」的东西从钱币扩展到帮助：好建议和钱一样值。

senses.title: Worth the time spent
senses.definition: of an experience, worth having for what it teaches
senses.definitionCN: 形容一段经历因教益而值得拥有
senses.example: Working in the shop was a valuable experience.
senses.exampleCN: 在店里干过那段活是很有价值的经历。
senses.why: Time is a cost like money, so an experience that repays the time is called valuable too.
senses.whyCN: 时间也像钱一样是成本，因此一段能抵回时间的经历也被叫作 valuable。

senses.title: Small costly things kept together
senses.definition: in the plural, personal items of great worth such as jewellery
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指珠宝等值钱的私人物品
senses.example: Put your valuables in the hotel safe.
senses.exampleCN: 把贵重物品放进酒店保险箱。
senses.why: The adjective is turned into a plural noun for the costly things themselves, the ones worth locking away.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转成复数名词，指那些值钱、值得锁起来的东西本身。

intro.en: The adjective of worth, built on the Latin stem that also gives value and valour.
intro.cn: 表示「值得」的形容词，建在与 value、valour 相同的拉丁词干上。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong and to be worth; the noun valor named worth and courage.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、值得」，名词 valor 指价值与勇气。

items.en: French formed value from the popular Latin noun valuta, a thing worth so much.
items.cn: 法语从通俗拉丁语名词 valuta（值若干的东西）造出 value。

items.en: English adds -able to value and gets valuable, able to be worth much.
items.cn: 英语在 value 后加 -able 得到 valuable，意为「能值很多的」。

items.en: The plural valuables names costly personal things kept safe.
items.cn: 复数 valuables 指收存妥当的贵重私人物品。

items.en: The sense widens to advice, information, and experiences that are worth having.
items.cn: 词义扩展到值得拥有的建议、信息与经历。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the worth family, and the near-meaning group sets the costly apart from the worthless and the priceless.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「值」的词族，近义组把贵重与毫无价值、无价之物放在一起。

entries.definition: worth or importance
entries.definitionCN: 价值

entries.definition: so precious that no price can be set, not worthless
entries.definitionCN: 无价的；极宝贵的（并非「没价值」）

entries.definition: having no worth at all
entries.definitionCN: 毫无价值的

entries.definition: an expert estimate of worth
entries.definitionCN: 估价；评价

entries.definition: of great worth and not to be lost
entries.definitionCN: 珍贵的

entries.definition: bought or kept at a high price
entries.definitionCN: 昂贵的

entries.definition: worth more than any price
entries.definitionCN: 无价的

entries.definition: having no value
entries.definitionCN: 毫无价值的

normalIntro.en: Turn value into an adjective with -able: it can be valued because it is worth something.
normalIntro.cn: 把 value 加 -able 变成形容词：因为值东西，所以可以被估出价。

normal.en: Valuables in the plural means jewellery and watches, not abstract worth.
normal.cn: 复数 valuables 指珠宝腕表，不是抽象价值。

normal.en: Invaluable is not the opposite of valuable; it means priceless.
normal.cn: invaluable 并非 valuable 的反义，而是「无价的」。

normal.en: Valuable to somebody is the usual frame for usefulness.
normal.cn: valuable to somebody 是表示「对某人有用」的常见框架。

normal.en: The comparative is more valuable, not valuabler.
normal.cn: 比较级用 more valuable，不用 valuabler。

normal.en: Value is the noun and verb behind it.
normal.cn: 背后的名词与动词是 value。

abstract.en: Picture a ring in cloth, engraved with a grandmother's name.
abstract.cn: 想象绒布里一枚刻着祖母名字的戒指。

abstract.en: Hear advice at a first job that saves a month of mistakes.
abstract.cn: 听入职时的一句建议，省下一个月弯路。

abstract.en: See a list taped to a hotel door asking you to use the safe.
abstract.cn: 看酒店门上那张请你使用保险箱的纸条。

examples.en: The painting turned out to be far more valuable than expected.
examples.cn: 这幅画结果比预想的贵重得多。

examples.en: Your comments were valuable, and the report is clearer now.
examples.cn: 你的意见很有价值，报告现在清楚多了。

examples.en: Guests are asked to leave valuables at the front desk.
examples.cn: 客人被要求把贵重物品寄存在前台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「歪流包」——宝物流到歪处也得包起来收好。

root: 拉丁语 valere（值得、强壮）→ 名词 value，加形容词后缀 -able 构成 valuable

sensesIntro.en: The core of worth spreads from price to help, to time well spent, and to precious things named in the plural.
sensesIntro.cn: 「值得」这个核心从价格扩展到帮助，再扩展到值得花的时间，最后成为复数形式所指的贵重物品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old ring wrapped in cloth at the bottom of a box.
core.cn: 核心意象：木箱底部绒布包着的一枚旧戒指。

branches.en: The price branch: it would sell high.
branches.cn: 价格分支：能卖个好价。

branches.en: The help branch: it makes things better.
branches.cn: 帮助分支：它让事情变好。

branches.en: The experience branch: time that returns more than it cost.
branches.cn: 经历分支：花出去的时间回本更多。

branches.en: The noun branch: the costly objects themselves.
branches.cn: 名词分支：贵重物品本身。

branches.en: The judgement branch: worth is counted in money or in benefit.
branches.cn: 评判分支：价值或以钱计，或以益计。

intro.en: Worth turned into an adjective with -able, with a negative and a privative partner close by.
intro.cn: 把「值得」用 -able 变成形容词，旁边还有否定与「无」两个伙伴。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere, to be worth, gives value; adding -able gives the adjective, adding in- gives invaluable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere（值得）给出 value；加 -able 成形容词，加 in- 成 invaluable。

items.example: Value is what the adjective measures.
items.exampleCN: value 是这个形容词衡量的东西。

items.example: The root val- sits behind the family.
items.exampleCN: 词根 val- 支撑整个词族。

items.example: Worth is the plain English twin.
items.exampleCN: worth 是朴素的英语孪生词。

definition_zh: 价值；价格；重要性；重视；估量
definition_en: the worth of something in money or in importance, or to think highly of it
core_image: 旧货商把一只旧表端在手里，翻看背面刻字
scene: 旧货铺里，老板把一只黄铜表翻过来，看背面的刻字和磨损，然后才报出一个数。The dealer set a value of two hundred on the watch.
sceneCN: 这里 value 是「价值、估价」（第 1 个义项：值多少）；句意为旧货商给那只表估了两百。端表翻看的画面，正是这个词的核心。

pos.zh: 价值；价格
重要性；意义
重视；珍视
估价；评价

derivatives.zh: 加 -able 构成形容词，义为「有价值的」
加 in- 与 -able 构成，义为「无价的」
加 -ation 构成名词，义为「估价」
加 -less 构成，义为「毫无价值的」

senses.title: Worth in money
senses.definition: the amount of money something is worth or would sell for
senses.definitionCN: 某物值多少钱或能卖多少钱
senses.example: The value of the house has doubled in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子十年间价值翻了一倍。
senses.why: Latin valere meant to be worth, and the noun first names what a thing can be exchanged for.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 valere 意为「值得」，这个名词最初指一件东西能换来的那个数目。

senses.title: Worth in importance
senses.definition: the importance or usefulness of something that is not for sale
senses.definitionCN: 某些非卖品的重要性或用处
senses.example: The value of the trip lay in the people she met.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行的价值在于她遇见的人。
senses.why: If worth can be counted, it need not be counted in coins, so the word moves to things that are priceless.
senses.whyCN: 既然「值」可以计量，就不必只以钱币计量，于是词义挪到了无价之物上。

senses.title: To think highly of something
senses.definition: to consider something important and worth keeping
senses.definitionCN: 认为某物重要、值得保留
senses.example: He values his friends more than his salary.
senses.exampleCN: 他看重朋友胜过薪水。
senses.why: To see worth in something is to prize it, so the noun becomes a verb of holding dear.
senses.whyCN: 看出一件事的价值就是看重它，于是名词转成了表示珍惜的动词。

senses.title: To estimate the worth of something
senses.definition: to work out how much money something is worth
senses.definitionCN: 算定某物值多少钱
senses.example: The house was valued at a lower figure last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子去年的估价更低。
senses.why: The other verb use keeps the money sense: to value is to put a figure on what something is worth.
senses.whyCN: 动词的另一用法保留了钱款义：value 就是给某物定一个价。

senses.title: A belief about what matters
senses.definition: in the plural, the beliefs a person or group holds about right and wrong
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指个人或群体对是非的观念
senses.example: The school says it teaches traditional values.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校称它教授传统观念。
senses.why: The things a group prizes are its values, so the plural names beliefs rather than prices.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体所看重的东西就是它的 values，因此复数指观念而不是价格。

intro.en: The Latin root of worth, borrowed through French as a noun and then turned into a verb in English.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「值得」的词根，经法语借入作名词，后在英语中转为动词。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong or to be worth, and valor named worth and courage.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、值得」，valor 指价值与勇气。

items.en: The feminine participle valuta meant a thing worth so much.
items.cn: 阴性分词 valuta 意为「值若干的东西」。

items.en: French valoir and the noun value carried the sense of worth into use.
items.cn: 法语 valoir 与名词 value 把「值」这一意义带入使用。

items.en: English borrows value as a noun of price and worth.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 value，作价格与价值的名词。

items.en: The verb senses of prizing and pricing grow, and the plural values names beliefs.
items.cn: 表示珍视与估价的动词义发展起来，复数 values 指观念。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the worth family, and the near-meaning group sets worth against price and cost.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「值」的词族，近义组把价值与价格、成本放在一起。

entries.definitionCN: 有价值的；贵重的

entries.definition: legally or logically sound
entries.definitionCN: 有效的；站得住脚的

entries.definition: an estimate of worth
entries.definitionCN: 估价

entries.definition: courage in battle
entries.definitionCN: 英勇

entries.definition: the native word for value
entries.definitionCN: 价值（英语本土词）

entries.definition: the money asked for goods
entries.definitionCN: 价格

entries.definition: what is given up to get something
entries.definitionCN: 成本

entries.definition: worth of a good quality
entries.definitionCN: 优点；价值

normalIntro.en: One noun covers both the price on a tag and the worth a person refuses to sell.
normalIntro.cn: 一个名词同时覆盖标签上的价格与人情里不肯出售的价值。

normal.en: Value for money is the standard phrase in shopping and reviews.
normal.cn: value for money 是购物与评测中的标准说法。

normal.en: Values in the plural means beliefs, not prices.
normal.cn: 复数 values 指观念，不是价格。

normal.en: The verb takes both frames: value a friend, value a house.
normal.cn: 这个动词两种框架都用：value a friend 与 value a house。

normal.en: Valuable and invaluable look like opposites but are not.
normal.cn: valuable 与 invaluable 看着像反义，其实不是。

normal.en: Valuation is the formal word from the same stem.
normal.cn: valuation 是同词干上的正式名词。

abstract.en: Picture a dealer turning a brass watch to read the engraving.
abstract.cn: 想象旧货商翻过黄铜表看刻字。

abstract.en: See a friend keep a letter that has no price at all.
abstract.cn: 看朋友留着一封无从标价的信。

abstract.en: Hear a school claim it teaches old-fashioned values.
abstract.cn: 听一所学校说它教老式的观念。

examples.en: The value of the land rose sharply after the road was built.
examples.cn: 修路之后这块地的价值猛涨。

examples.en: She values honesty more than politeness.
examples.cn: 她看重诚实胜过礼貌。

examples.en: The painting was valued at ten thousand pounds.
examples.cn: 这幅画被估价一万英镑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为留」——有价值的东西才值得为之留下来。

root: 拉丁语 valere（值得、强壮）的阴性分词 valuta（价值），经古法语 value 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: The core of worth gives money, then importance, then the two verbs of prizing and pricing, and finally the beliefs people hold.
sensesIntro.cn: 「值得」这个核心先给出钱款，再给出重要性，再给出珍视与估价两个动词，最后给出人们所持的观念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dealer turning a brass watch in his hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧货商手里翻看一只黄铜表。

branches.en: The price branch: a figure on a tag.
branches.cn: 价格分支：标签上的数字。

branches.en: The meaning branch: worth without a price.
branches.cn: 意义分支：无价的价值。

branches.en: The holding branch: friendship kept above salary.
branches.cn: 持有分支：友情重于薪水。

branches.en: The pricing branch: an expert puts a number on it.
branches.cn: 定价分支：专家给出一个数字。

branches.en: The belief branch: shared ideas of what matters.
branches.cn: 观念分支：共同认定的重要之事。

intro.en: A Latin root of worth carried into English through French, later hosting a crowd of suffixes.
intro.cn: 一个表示「值得」的拉丁词根经法语进入英语，后来又接上了一大串后缀。

latinIntro.en: Valere, to be worth, gives valuta; French shortens it to value, and English takes value as both noun and verb.
latinIntro.cn: valere（值得）给出 valuta；法语缩为 value，英语把 value 同时用作名词与动词。

items.example: The root covers worth and strength together.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根同时覆盖价值与强壮。

items.example: The ending shows a borrowed noun.
items.exampleCN: 这一词尾显示是借入名词。

items.example: Worth and value answer each other.
items.exampleCN: worth 与 value 彼此对应。

latinEntries.meaning: to be worth, to be strong

definition_zh: 货车；厢式车；面包车；（英）火车行李车厢
definition_en: a covered vehicle for carrying goods or people, smaller than a lorry and closed at the back
core_image: 一辆白色厢式车后门打开，里面堆着纸箱
scene: 楼下的面包车横在门口，后门敞开，两个工人开始往外搬成摞的纸箱。The delivery van blocked the narrow street.
sceneCN: 这里 van 是「厢式货车、面包车」（第 1 个义项：运货或载人的封闭车辆）；句意为那辆送货车堵住了狭窄的街道。后门敞开、堆满纸箱的画面，正是这个词的核心。

pos.zh: 货车；厢式车
（英）行李车厢

derivatives.zh: 古英语中的同形词，义为「簸箕；风选工具」
同源家族词，义为「大篷车；房车」
复合词，义为「运货司机」
复合词，义为「一车的量」

senses.title: A covered vehicle for goods
senses.definition: a road vehicle with a roof and closed sides, used for carrying goods
senses.definitionCN: 有顶、两侧封闭、用于运货的公路车辆
senses.example: They moved the whole flat in one van.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一辆货车装下了整套公寓的东西。
senses.why: The clipped word keeps the covered body of the older caravan, and a covered body is what carries goods.
senses.whyCN: 这个截短词保留了 caravan 的带篷车身，而带篷的车身正是用来装货的。

senses.title: A vehicle for carrying people
senses.definition: a closed vehicle used to carry a small group of people
senses.definitionCN: 用于载少数人的封闭车辆
senses.example: A van takes the children to school each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 每天早上有一辆面包车送孩子们上学。
senses.why: The same closed box that holds boxes can hold people, so the vehicle needs only seats instead of crates.
senses.whyCN: 同一只装货的封闭箱子也能装人，于是车里的纸箱换成座位就成了面包车。

senses.title: A railway carriage for luggage or parcels
senses.definition: in British English, a separate railway carriage for luggage, mail, or goods
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中指单独的行李、邮件或货物车厢
senses.example: Leave your cases in the guard's van.
senses.exampleCN: 把箱子放在列车员的行李车厢里。
senses.why: Railways named their goods and luggage cars after the road wagon, so a van on rails carries the same load.
senses.whyCN: 铁路把运货与载行李的车厢按公路货车的名字命名，于是铁轨上的 van 也装着同样的东西。

senses.title: A short form of caravan
senses.definition: in British use, the short form of caravan, a vehicle towed for holidays
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中为 caravan 的简称，指拖挂式假日房车
senses.example: They spent a wet week in a van by the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在海边的一辆房车里度过了一个阴雨周。
senses.why: Since van began as a clipping of caravan, the full word and the short one still overlap in British speech.
senses.whyCN: 既然 van 本来就是 caravan 的截短，全形与短形在英国口语里仍然交叠。

intro.en: A clipped form of caravan, which came to English from Persian by way of French and Latin.
intro.cn: caravan 的截短形式，而 caravan 是从波斯语经法语与拉丁语进入英语的。

items.en: Karwan named a company of merchants or pilgrims travelling together.
items.cn: karwan 指结队同行的商队或朝圣者。

items.en: Latin took the word as caravana, a group of travellers.
items.cn: 拉丁语取用为 caravana，指结队的旅人。

items.en: French caravane named both the travellers and the covered wagon they used.
items.cn: 法语 caravane 兼指旅队与他们所乘的带篷车。

items.en: English caravan comes to mean any covered wagon, and later a towed holiday home.
items.cn: 英语 caravan 先泛指带篷车，后来指拖挂的假日房车。

items.en: Van is the clipped form, first of caravan, then a word for a covered goods vehicle.
items.cn: van 是其截短形式，先指 caravan，后指有篷的运货车辆。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the caravan family the word was clipped from, and the near-meaning group places it by size and shape among other vehicles.
note.cn: 形近组收集 van 所从截出的 caravan 词族，近义组按大小与形状把它放在其他车辆之间。

entries.definition: a covered wagon or a towed holiday home
entries.definitionCN: 带篷车；拖挂式房车

entries.definition: a driver of a van
entries.definitionCN: 货车司机

entries.definition: as much as a van can carry
entries.definitionCN: 一车之量

entries.definition: an inn where caravans stayed
entries.definitionCN: 商队客店

entries.definitionCN: （英）卡车

entries.definition: a large goods vehicle in American English

entries.definitionCN: 四轮运货车；车皮

entries.definition: a small bus for around a dozen people
entries.definitionCN: 小型客车

normalIntro.en: Four letters for a box on wheels with a roof: something goes inside and moves.
normalIntro.cn: 四个字母，指一只装了轮子、盖了顶的箱子：东西装进去就运走。

normal.en: A removal van moves furniture, a delivery van brings parcels.
normal.cn: removal van 搬家具，delivery van 送包裹。

normal.en: The British luggage van means a railway carriage, not a road vehicle.
normal.cn: 英式的 luggage van 指铁路车厢，不是公路车辆。

normal.en: Van is short for caravan in British holiday talk.
normal.cn: 英式度假语境里 van 是 caravan 的简称。

normal.en: The plural is simply vans.
normal.cn: 复数直接加 s。

normal.en: Caravan keeps the full older shape of the word.
normal.cn: caravan 保留了较早的全形。

abstract.en: Picture back doors open and cardboard boxes piled inside.
abstract.cn: 想象后门打开，里面堆着纸箱。

abstract.en: Hear a van idle at dawn outside a bakery.
abstract.cn: 听黎明时面包店外一辆货车空转。

abstract.en: See children climb into a school van in the rain.
abstract.cn: 看孩子们在雨里钻进校车。

examples.en: The van was too high to enter the car park.
examples.cn: 那辆货车太高，进不了停车场。

examples.en: Two men carried the sofa out to the van.
examples.cn: 两个人把沙发抬到了货车上。

examples.en: The guard's van is at the back of the train.
examples.cn: 列车员的行李车厢在列车尾部。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弯」——大车拐弯费劲，厢式车的「弯」也是它起名的一声。

root: van 为 caravan（大篷车）的截短形式，caravan 出自中世纪拉丁语 caravana，溯源为波斯语 karwan（结队的旅人）

sensesIntro.en: A covered wagon becomes a goods vehicle, then a people carrier, then a railway luggage car, and in Britain a shortened caravan.
sensesIntro.cn: 带篷车先成为运货车辆，再成为载人车辆，再成为铁路行李车厢，在英国还成了 caravan 的简称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white van with its back doors open.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆白色厢式车后门敞开。

branches.en: The delivery branch: parcels in and out all day.
branches.cn: 配送分支：整天进进出出卖包裹。

branches.en: The passenger branch: a small group seated inside.
branches.cn: 乘客分支：车里坐着一小群人。

branches.en: The railway branch: cases ride in their own coach.
branches.cn: 铁路分支：箱子坐自己的车厢。

branches.en: The holiday branch: a towed caravan shortened.
branches.cn: 度假分支：拖挂房车的简称。

branches.en: The shape branch: a roof and closed sides define the van.
branches.cn: 形状分支：有顶有侧壁才是厢式车。

intro.en: A clipped word: caravan lost its head and kept its tail.
intro.cn: 一个截短词：caravan 丢掉了头，留下了尾。

latinIntro.cn: 全形 caravan 经拉丁语与法语来自波斯语 karwan；四字母的 van 里已没有可拆的拉丁成分。

definition_zh: 消失；突然不见；使（某物）消失；灭绝、不复存在
definition_en: to disappear suddenly and completely
core_image: 一只兔子被人一晃，转眼连影子都不见了
scene: 魔术师掀开黑色幕布，台上那只鸟扑扇了两下就不见了。The coin vanished from his hand before we could blink.
sceneCN: 这里 vanish 是「消失、突然不见」（第 1 个义项：突然且彻底地不见）；句意为那枚硬币在我们眨眼之前就从他手里消失了。鸟连影子都没留下，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 动词：消失、突然不见；使消失；灭绝、不复存在

derivatives.zh: 形容词，义为「消失的、正在逐渐消失的」，如 vanishing point
形容词，义为「已消失的、不复存在的」
名词，义为「虚荣、空虚」，与 vanish 同源于拉丁语 vanus「空的」
形容词，义为「迅速消逝的」，同源且更书面
名词短语，义为「消失点、尽头」

senses.title: To disappear suddenly
senses.definition: to disappear suddenly and completely from sight
senses.definitionCN: 突然且彻底地从视野中消失
senses.example: The coin vanished from his hand before we could blink.
senses.exampleCN: 那枚硬币在我们眨眼之前就从他手里消失了。
senses.why: Latin vanus means empty; what vanishes leaves empty space where it stood.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 vanus 意为「空的」；消失之物站过的地方就空了下来。

senses.title: To disappear by magic
senses.titleCN: 被变没了：靠手法让东西不见
senses.definition: to make something disappear as if by magic, or to disappear that way
senses.definitionCN: 像变戏法一样使某物消失，或那样消失
senses.example: The magician made the silk scarf vanish in a flash.
senses.exampleCN: 魔术师一下子让那条丝巾消失不见了。
senses.why: Magic borrows the word for the most literal emptiness: the object is gone and the hand is shown empty.
senses.whyCN: 魔术借这个词表达最字面的「空」：物件没了，手心也摊开是空的。

senses.title: To stop existing
senses.titleCN: 不存在了：彻底消失、灭绝
senses.definition: to cease to exist, often gradually and on a large scale
senses.definitionCN: 不再存在，常指逐渐、大范围地消失
senses.example: Many small languages may vanish within this century.
senses.exampleCN: 许多小语种可能在本世纪内消失。
senses.why: The empty place is no longer a spot on stage but a whole category that is gone.
senses.whyCN: 这个空位不再只是舞台上的一块地方，而是一整个类别不复存在。

senses.title: To fade from use
senses.titleCN: 淡出使用：渐渐从日常里退场
senses.definition: to disappear from common use or from memory
senses.definitionCN: 从常用范围或记忆中淡出
senses.example: The old custom has almost vanished from the countryside.
senses.exampleCN: 这项旧风俗在乡间已几乎消失。
senses.why: Nothing dramatic is needed; the word covers quiet absence as well as sudden loss.
senses.whyCN: 不必有戏剧性场面；这个词既指突然丢失，也指安静的缺席。

senses.title: To become zero
senses.definition: to drop suddenly to nothing, said of amounts or chances
senses.definitionCN: 指数量或机会突然降到零
senses.example: All our savings vanished in one bad deal.
senses.exampleCN: 所有积蓄在一次糟糕的交易中化为乌有。
senses.why: A number that disappears leaves the same empty place as an object that disappears.
senses.whyCN: 一个消失的数字留下的空位，和消失的物件完全相同。

intro.en: Vanish goes back to Latin vanus, empty, through the verb evanescere, to pass away.
intro.cn: vanish 上溯到拉丁语 vanus「空的」，经由动词 evanescere「逝去」而来。

items.en: The adjective vanus meant empty, hollow or without substance.
items.cn: 形容词 vanus 意为空的、虚的、没有实质的。

items.en: The verb evanescere meant to pass away or fade from sight, built with the prefix e- meaning out.
items.cn: 动词 evanescere 意为逝去、从视野中淡出，由表示向外的前缀 e- 构成。

items.en: Old French esvanir shortened the word and kept the sense of disappearing completely.
items.cn: 古法语 esvanir 缩短了这个词，保留了彻底消失的意思。

items.en: English took the word in the fourteenth century, spelling it variously before settling on vanish.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，拼法几经变化才定成 vanish。

items.en: Modern English extended it from objects disappearing to languages, customs and sums of money.
items.cn: 现代英语把它从物件消失扩展到语言、风俗与金钱。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the Latin stem of emptiness; the near-meaning group holds verbs of going out of sight.
note.cn: 形近组沿表达「空」的拉丁词干；近义组收表示离开视野的动词。

entries.definition: Emptiness turned into pride; same Latin vanus.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「虚荣」，同出拉丁 vanus「空的」。

entries.definition: Fading quickly away, closer to the Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「迅速消逝的」，更接近拉丁动词形式。

entries.definition: The act of disappearing; used in vanishing point.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「消失（的）」，见于 vanishing point。

entries.definition: A rare noun for the state of being gone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，罕用，义为「消失的状态」。

entries.definition: The plain word for going out of sight, without the suddenness.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「不见了」，最普通的说法，不带突兀感。

entries.definition: To grow weaker and less visible by degrees.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「渐渐褪去」，一点一点变淡。

entries.definition: To turn into vapour, or to melt away like vapour.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「蒸发」，像汽一样散去。

entries.definition: To break up and pass into nothing or into a liquid.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「溶解、消散」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the empty-space core and phrases such as vanish into thin air.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用「空出位置」的核心意象与 vanish into thin air 这类搭配。

normal.en: Vanish shares a root with vanity: both come from a Latin word for empty.
normal.cn: vanish 与 vanity 同根，都出自拉丁语「空的」。

normal.en: Vanish into thin air is the phrase for a disappearance with no explanation.
normal.cn: vanish into thin air 指毫无解释地不见。

normal.en: A magician makes things vanish, but the hand is simply faster than the eye.
normal.cn: 魔术师让东西消失，其实只是手比眼快。

normal.en: Languages and customs vanish slowly, coins vanish at once.
normal.cn: 语言与风俗消失得慢，硬币却是立刻就没了。

normal.en: Vanish from sight means the eye loses it, not that it never existed.
normal.cn: vanish from sight 指眼睛看不见了，而不是它从未存在。

abstract.en: The word keeps pointing at a hole: something stood here, and now only the outline remains.
abstract.cn: 这个词一直指着那个洞：刚才这里还有东西，如今只剩下轮廓。

abstract.en: Disappearance is a change in the viewer, not always in the thing: vanish describes what the eye reports.
abstract.cn: 消失有时是观看者的变化而非事物的变化：这个词记录的是眼睛的报告。

abstract.en: A word built on emptiness can describe magic, extinction and debt with one motion of the hand.
abstract.cn: 一个以「空」为根的词，用一个挥手的动作就能讲魔术、灭绝与破产。

examples.en: The sun vanished behind the clouds.
examples.cn: 太阳消失在云层后面。

examples.en: He vanished into the crowd before anyone could stop him.
examples.cn: 还没人拦住他，他就消失在人群里了。

examples.en: The keys seem to have vanished from the table.
examples.cn: 钥匙好像从桌上消失了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哇泥石」——哇，泥石流一来，房子瞬间不见了：消失

root: 源自拉丁语形容词 vanus「空的」及其动词 evanescere「逝去」，经古法语 esvanir 于十四世纪进入英语；同族词有 vanity、evanescent。

sensesIntro.en: Vanish runs from a coin leaving a hand, through magic and extinction, to habits and savings that empty out.
sensesIntro.cn: vanish 从手里飞走的硬币，经魔术与灭绝，到淡出的风俗与归零的存款。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an object leaves and the place where it stood is suddenly empty.
core.cn: 核心意象：物件离场，它待过的地方突然空了。

branches.en: SIGHT LINE: the eye loses the object at once.
branches.cn: 视觉线：眼睛一下子抓不到物件。

branches.en: STAGE LINE: the hand is shown empty on purpose.
branches.cn: 舞台线：手心故意摊开给人看是空的。

branches.en: EXISTENCE LINE: whole languages and customs quietly go.
branches.cn: 存在线：整门语言与风俗悄然退场。

branches.en: NUMBER LINE: the amount falls to zero.
branches.cn: 数值线：数字一下落到零。

branches.en: CONTRAST: vanish is sudden, fade is gradual.
branches.cn: 对照线：vanish 突兀，fade 渐缓。

intro.en: Vanish carries a Latin root for emptiness plus English verb endings; its relatives hide in common words.
intro.cn: vanish 带一个表示「空」的拉丁词根和英语动词词尾，它的亲属藏在常见词里。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is vanus, empty, with the verb evanescere behind the first syllable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语基础是 vanus「空的」，开头的 e- 则来自动词 evanescere。

items.example: It carries the core of vanish.
items.exampleCN: 它承载 vanish 的核心义。

definition_zh: 可变性；变异性；变动幅度；（统计）离散程度
definition_en: the quality or degree of being changeable, or the extent to which values differ from one another
core_image: 同一块地的十次收成排成一列，高低差别明显，尺子量出的正是这些差别
scene: 这里指「可变性」。 Rainfall variability makes farming risky in this region.
sceneCN: 这里 variability 指「变动幅度」（第 1 个义项：随时间或个案变化、不稳定）；句意：降水量的变动使该地区的农业风险很大。图中可辨识物件：逐年降水柱状图、干裂的田块、蓄水池。

pos.zh: 可变性；变异性；变动幅度；（统计）离散程度（多为不可数，也可用 variabilities 指多种变异）

derivatives.zh: 易变的；变量
变化；使不同
变化；变异；变奏
方差；差异；分歧
变体；异体；不同的
各种各样的；不同的

senses.title: Changeability
senses.definition: the quality of being changeable
senses.definitionCN: 容易发生变化的性质
senses.example: Rainfall variability makes farming risky in this region.
senses.exampleCN: 降水量的变化使该地区的农业风险很大。
senses.why: Varius in Latin meant 'diverse, spotted, changeable'. The noun -ability turns that quality into a measurable thing: not 'it changes' but 'how much it changes'.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 varius 意为「多样的、有斑点的、易变的」。名词后缀 -ability 把这种性质变成可度量之物：不是「它变」，而是「它变得有多少」。

senses.title: Statistical Spread
senses.titleCN: 统计离散：数值彼此差多少
senses.definition: the extent to which values in a set differ from one another
senses.definitionCN: 一组数值之间相互差异的程度
senses.example: The variability of the scores was low, so the class was evenly matched.
senses.exampleCN: 分数的离散程度很低，说明这个班水平相当。
senses.why: Statistics needs a word for difference rather than average. Variability measures how far the members scatter, which is why it pairs with standard deviation and range.
senses.whyCN: 统计学需要一个词来表示「差异」而不是「平均」；variability 量的是成员分散得多远，因此它与标准差、极差等概念搭配。

senses.title: Biological Variation
senses.titleCN: 生物变异：同种个体间的差异
senses.definition: the range of differences among individuals of a species
senses.definitionCN: 同一物种个体之间的差异范围
senses.example: Genetic variability gives a population a chance to survive a new disease.
senses.exampleCN: 遗传变异让一个种群有机会熬过新的疾病。
senses.why: Evolution depends on differences, not on uniformity. Here variability is a resource: the wider the spread, the more likely some member fits a changed world.
senses.whyCN: 演化依赖差异而非整齐划一。此时 variability 是一种资源：分布越宽，越可能有某个成员适应改变了的世界。

senses.title: Climate Fluctuation
senses.definition: the degree to which climate conditions differ from year to year or place to place
senses.definitionCN: 气候条件在年际或地点之间的差异程度
senses.example: Natural variability hides the slower trend for decades.
senses.exampleCN: 自然波动会在数十年里掩盖较慢的趋势。
senses.why: A trend is a direction; variability is the noise around it. Climate science separates the two, because a wet year says nothing about a warming century.
senses.whyCN: 趋势是方向，变率是围绕方向的噪声。气候科学要把两者分开，因为一个多雨的年份说明不了整个世纪在变暖。

senses.title: Measurement Noise
senses.titleCN: 测量波动：同一对象反复测出的差别
senses.definition: the differences between repeated measurements of the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 对同一对象反复测量所得结果之间的差异
senses.example: The variability between the three readings came from the old balance.
senses.exampleCN: 三次读数的波动来自那台旧天平。
senses.why: Instruments never repeat perfectly. The noun names that scatter, and a low value is a sign of a trustworthy method rather than of a stable world.
senses.whyCN: 仪器从不完美重复；这个名词命名的正是那种分散，而数值低说明方法可信，并不说明世界稳定。

senses.title: Beat-to-Beat Range
senses.titleCN: 心率变异性：逐次心跳的间隔差
senses.definition: the variation in the time between heartbeats
senses.definitionCN: 心跳之间时间间隔的变化
senses.example: High heart rate variability is usually a sign of a healthy nervous system.
senses.exampleCN: 较高的心率变异性通常意味着神经系统健康。
senses.why: Medicine uses the statistical sense on a living signal. A perfectly regular pulse can be a warning, so variability here is not noise but information.
senses.whyCN: 医学把统计义用在活体信号上；完全规律的脉搏反而可能是警讯，因此这里的变异性不是噪声，而是信息。

senses.title: Genetic Range
senses.titleCN: 遗传变异度：基因库里的多样性
senses.definition: the amount of genetic difference carried within a group
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体内部所携带的遗传差异总量
senses.example: The island population lost much of its genetic variability.
senses.exampleCN: 这个岛屿种群失去了大部分遗传变异。
senses.why: Small populations lose variants by chance. The word then measures a store of options, which conservation biology treats as something to protect.
senses.whyCN: 小种群会因偶然丢失变体；此时这个词量的是选项的储备，保护生物学把它当作需要保护的对象。

senses.title: Inconsistency of Quality
senses.definition: the unevenness of quality or performance over time
senses.definitionCN: 质量或表现在时间上的不均衡
senses.example: Customers complained about the variability of the product.
senses.exampleCN: 顾客抱怨该产品的质量波动。
senses.why: In manufacturing, variability is the enemy of trust: two units of the same model should behave alike. The word shifts from description to a defect to be reduced.
senses.whyCN: 在制造业，变异性是信任的敌人：同一型号的两件产品应当表现一致。此时该词从描述变成一种应当被降低的缺陷。

intro.en: Variability is formed from variable plus -ity, and variable comes from Latin variabilis, from variare 'to change', from varius 'diverse, spotted'. The origin of varius itself is uncertain, and the first English date is only approximate.
intro.cn: variability 由 variable 加 -ity 构成；variable 出自拉丁 variabilis，来自 variare「变化」，而 variare 又来自 varius「多样的、有斑点的」。varius 本身的来源不确定，英语首见年代仅为约数。

items.en: Varius meant 'of various kinds, spotted, mottled, changeable'. Its deeper origin is uncertain: some connect it with a root for 'to weave or vary', but no source is agreed.
items.cn: varius 意为「多种多样的、有斑点的、斑驳的、易变的」。它更深的来源不确定：有人把它与表示「编织、变化」的词根联系起来，但没有公认的来源。此处标注为来源不确定。

items.en: The verb variare meant 'to diversify, to change, to alternate'. It was used for colouring, for altering a plan and for taking turns.
items.cn: 动词 variare 意为「使多样、改变、交替」，可用于上色、改变计划，也可指轮流。

items.en: Variabilis meant 'changeable, inconstant'. Latin built it with the suffix -bilis, 'able to be', which English keeps in -able.
items.cn: variabilis 意为「可变的、不恒定的」。拉丁语用后缀 -bilis「能够被……」构成它，英语以 -able 保留了这个后缀。

items.en: English variable appears in the fifteenth century from Old French. Variability followed later, adding -ity to make the quality into a noun. Exact first citations are uncertain.
items.cn: 英语 variable 于十五世纪经古法语出现；variability 稍后加上 -ity，把这种性质变成名词。确切的首见书证不确定。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries variability acquired a technical sense in statistics and biology: the measurable spread of a set of observations. The old idea of changeability became a number.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪，variability 在统计学与生物学中获得专门含义：一组观测值可测量的离散程度。古老的「易变」观念由此变成了一个数字。

note.en: The first group separates nouns and adjectives of the same Latin family that are easy to mix. The second holds near-synonyms from statistics and everyday speech.
note.cn: 第一组区分同出拉丁词族、容易混淆的名词与形容词；第二组是统计学与日常用语中的近义词。

entries.definition: A particular change or difference, or the act of varying. It counts differences; variability measures how large the differences are.
entries.definitionCN: 指某一具体变化或差异，或变化的行为；它数差异的个数，而 variability 量差异的大小。

entries.definition: In statistics, the average squared deviation; in law, a permission to depart from a rule. It is a precise quantity, not a general quality.
entries.definitionCN: 统计学中指离差平方的平均值；法律中指对规则适用的例外许可。它是精确的量，不是一般的性质。

entries.definition: The adjective 'changeable' or the noun for a quantity that can take different values. The noun names the thing that varies, not the amount of varying.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词「易变的」，或指可取不同值的量；该名词命名的是会变的东西，而不是变化的幅度。

entries.definition: An irregular rising and falling, as of prices. It stresses movement up and down rather than the spread of values.
entries.definitionCN: 不规则地上下起伏，如价格；强调上下运动，而不是数值的分散。

entries.definition: A tendency to change or become unbalanced. It carries more risk and less measurement than variability.
entries.definitionCN: 倾向于变化或失衡；比 variability 含更多风险意味，更少测量意味。

entries.definition: The presence of many different kinds. It counts variety of types, while variability measures differences within a measure.
entries.definitionCN: 存在许多不同种类；它数类型的多样，而 variability 量同一度量内的差异。

entries.definition: The spreading of values around a centre. It is a technical near-synonym of variability in statistics.
entries.definitionCN: 数值围绕中心散布；在统计学中是 variability 的技术性近义词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: varius 'varied' + -able 'able to' + -ity: the quality of being able to vary.
normal.cn: varius「多样的」+ -able「能够」+ -ity：能够变化的性质。

normal.en: The family runs vary, variable, variability, variation, variance, variant, various.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 vary、variable、variability、variation、variance、variant、various。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: climate variability, genetic variability, heart rate variability, measurement variability.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：气候变率、遗传变异度、心率变异性、测量波动。

normal.en: variability is how much things differ; variation is a particular difference.
normal.cn: variability 是差异有多大，variation 是某一处具体的差异。

normal.en: Low variability in a factory is good; high variability in a gene pool is good.
normal.cn: 工厂里变异性低是好事，基因库里变异性高是好事。

abstract.en: Picture a row of ten identical cups, then a row where every cup is a different height.
abstract.cn: 想象一排十只一模一样的杯子，再想象一排每只高度都不同的杯子。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid across a scatter of dots to show how far they wander from the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺横放在散乱的点上，用来显示它们离中心有多远。

abstract.en: Picture a heartbeat that is never exactly on time, and a doctor smiling at the irregularity.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗从不准时的心跳，而医生对这种不规则微笑。

examples.en: The study measured the variability of response times across four groups.
examples.cn: 该研究测量了四组反应时间的波动程度。

examples.en: High variability in rainfall forces farmers to store water.
examples.cn: 降水的剧烈变动迫使农民储水。

examples.en: Reducing variability is the first aim of any production line.
examples.cn: 降低波动是任何生产线的首要目标。

dict_mnemonic.text: variable（可变的）+ ility（性质）→ 可变的程度 → 可变性、变异性

root: 拉丁 varius「多样的、有斑点的」（来源不确定）→ variare「变化」→ variabilis「可变的」→ 英语 variable → variability。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all measure how much something differs: a general quality, a statistical spread, biological difference, climate noise, instrument scatter, heartbeat range, genetic variety and uneven quality.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在量「差异有多大」：一般性质、统计离散、生物差异、气候噪声、仪器散布、心跳间隔、遗传多样与质量起伏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of unequal harvests, and a ruler laid across the differences.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排高低不等的收成，一把尺子横放在这些差异之上。

branches.en: QUALITY BECOMES QUANTITY: a vague property of being changeable turns into a measurable spread.
branches.cn: 性质变成数量：模糊的「易变」性质变成了可测量的离散度。

branches.en: VARIATION AS RESOURCE: genetic differences give a population options, and a narrow pool is a risk.
branches.cn: 变异作为资源：遗传差异给种群提供选项，而狭窄的基因库是一种风险。

branches.en: NOISE VERSUS TREND: year-to-year wobble can hide a slow direction for decades.
branches.cn: 噪声与趋势：年际抖动可以在数十年里掩盖缓慢的方向。

branches.en: READING A SIGNAL: in instruments the scatter means error, while in a heartbeat it can mean health.
branches.cn: 读取信号：在仪器上散布意味着误差，在心跳上却可能意味着健康。

branches.en: QUALITY CONTROL: identical products should behave alike, so variability becomes a defect to reduce.
branches.cn: 质量控制：相同产品应当表现一致，因此变异性成为需要降低的缺陷。

intro.en: Variability is a Latin-rooted adjective turned into a quality-noun: a root meaning 'varied', the suffix -able, and the suffix -ity.
intro.cn: variability 是拉丁词根的形容词转化为性质名词：表示「多样」的词根、后缀 -able，以及后缀 -ity。

latinIntro.en: Latin varius and variare supply vary, variable, variability, variation, variance, variant, various and varietas, the ancestor of variety.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 varius 与 variare 衍生 vary、variable、variability、variation、variance、variant、various，以及 variety 的祖形 varietas。

items.example: Variability in the data was greater than expected.
items.exampleCN: 数据的波动比预期更大。

items.meaning: changeable; a quantity that can vary
items.meaningCN: 易变的；可取不同值的量
items.example: Temperature is the key variable in the experiment.
items.exampleCN: 温度是该实验的关键变量。

items.meaning: a change; a difference in form
items.example: Slight variation in colour is normal.
items.exampleCN: 颜色的轻微差异是正常的。

items.meaningCN: 差异；离差平方的平均值
items.example: The variance of the sample was small.

items.meaning: a different form of the same thing
items.example: A rare variant appeared in the north.
items.exampleCN: 北方出现了一种罕见的变体。

items.example: The garden grows a wide variety of herbs.

latinEntries.meaningCN: 多样的；有斑点的；易变的（更深来源不确定）

definition_zh: 变量；可变因素；可变物；形容词：可变的、多变的、不稳定的
definition_en: something that can change, or likely to change
core_image: 温度计里的液柱一天里上上下下，数字始终不肯稳住
scene: 实验台上摊着记录表，同一组数据每隔一小时就微微变动一次。Weather is the hardest variable to control in an outdoor experiment.
sceneCN: 这里 variable 是「变量、可变因素」（第 1 个义项：会变的东西）；句意为天气是户外实验中最难控制的可变因素。液柱上下不定的样子，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 名词：变量；可变因素；可变物
形容词：可变的、多变的；不稳定的

derivatives.zh: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是本词的动词形式
名词，义为「可变性、变化幅度」
副词，义为「多变地、不定地」
加否定前缀 in- 构成，义为「不变的、恒定的」
形容词，义为「各种各样的」，同根

senses.title: A quantity that changes
senses.titleCN: 变量：数学里可取的数值会变
senses.definition: a letter or symbol that can take different numerical values
senses.definitionCN: 可以取不同数值的字母或符号
senses.example: In the equation, x is the variable and two is the constant.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个方程里，x 是变量，二则是常数。
senses.why: Latin variare means to change; a variable is simply the name for something allowed to change.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 variare 意为变化；变量就是「允许变化之物」的名字。

senses.title: A factor in an experiment
senses.titleCN: 实验因素：会影响结果的一项条件
senses.definition: a condition or factor that can differ and so affect a result
senses.definitionCN: 会变化并因此影响结果的条件或因素
senses.example: Weather is the hardest variable to control in an outdoor experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 天气是户外实验中最难控制的可变因素。
senses.why: Science isolates one changing factor at a time, and the word names that chosen factor.
senses.whyCN: 科学一次只隔离一个变化因素，这个词就指那个被选出的因素。

senses.title: Something able to change
senses.titleCN: 可变的东西：性质本身会变动
senses.definition: a thing or quality that is capable of changing
senses.definitionCN: 本身具有变化能力的事物或性质
senses.example: Rainfall in this valley is highly variable from year to year.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷的降雨量逐年变化很大。
senses.why: The noun and the adjective share one idea: capacity for change, not a fixed state.
senses.whyCN: 名词与形容词共有一个想法：具备变化的能力，而非固定状态。

senses.title: Changeable in character
senses.titleCN: 多变的：形容性格或天气靠不住
senses.definition: likely to change suddenly, used of weather, mood or moody people
senses.definitionCN: 容易突然改变，用于天气、情绪或反复无常的人
senses.example: She has a variable temper, sunny one hour and cold the next.
senses.exampleCN: 她脾气多变，一小时和颜悦色，下一小时就冷若冰霜。
senses.why: The abstract capacity for change becomes a judgement about reliability.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的变化能力，变成了对可靠性的判断。

senses.title: Not constant in cost
senses.titleCN: 可变的成本：随业务量上下浮动
senses.definition: changing with the level of activity, said of costs or prices
senses.definitionCN: 随活动量上下浮动，用于成本或价格
senses.example: Fuel is a variable cost that rises with every extra delivery.
senses.exampleCN: 燃油是一项可变成本，每多送一趟就上涨。
senses.why: Business reuses the mathematical idea: some numbers follow output instead of staying put.
senses.whyCN: 商业沿用了数学的想法：有些数字随产量走，而不是原地不动。

intro.en: Variable comes from Latin variare, to change, through the adjective variabilis and Old French.
intro.cn: variable 来自拉丁语动词 variare「变化」，经形容词 variabilis 与古法语进入英语。

items.en: The adjective varius described things spotted, mixed or of several kinds.
items.cn: 形容词 varius 描述斑驳的、混杂的或多种多样的事物。

items.en: From it came the verb variare, to make different or to alter.
items.cn: 由它派生动词 variare，意为使不同、改变。

items.en: The adjective variabilis meant able to change, built with the suffix -bilis meaning capable.
items.cn: 形容词 variabilis 意为「能变化的」，由后缀 -bilis「能……的」构成。

items.en: Old French passed the word on with the same sense of being changeable.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词传下来，仍保留「会变的」意思。

items.en: In modern mathematics variable became a noun naming the symbol allowed to change.
items.cn: 在现代数学里，variable 变成名词，指允许变化的那个符号。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the vari- stem; the near-meaning group holds words for change and for what is fixed.
note.cn: 形近组沿 vari- 词干；近义组收表示变化以及固定不变的词。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun, to change or differ.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是本词背后的动词。

entries.definition: Of several different kinds; the adjective of variety.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「各种各样的」，属 variety 一支。

entries.definition: A range of different kinds of the same thing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性、品种」。

entries.definition: A change or difference in amount or form.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「变化、变异」。

entries.definition: Able to change, plainer and less technical.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「易变的」，更通俗不带术语味。

entries.definition: Likely to shift or fall; carries a warning.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不稳定的」，带警示意味。

entries.definition: Staying the same; the natural opposite.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「恒定的、常数」，天然的反义词。

entries.definition: Something that affects a result, whether it changes or not.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「因素」，不论变与不变。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the vari- root and real pairs such as variable cost and independent variable.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用 vari- 词根以及 variable cost、independent variable 这样的真实搭配。

normal.en: Vary is the verb, variable is the thing that can vary.
normal.cn: vary 是动词，variable 是那个会变的东西。

normal.en: In maths the variable is the letter, the constant is the number.
normal.cn: 数学里变量是字母，常数是数字。

normal.en: An independent variable is the one you change on purpose.
normal.cn: independent variable 是你故意去改的那个量。

normal.en: Variable costs rise and fall with how much you produce.
normal.cn: variable cost 随产量上下浮动。

normal.en: Add in- and invariable means the opposite: never changing.
normal.cn: 加上 in-，invariable 就是反面：从不改变。

abstract.en: A variable is a slot rather than a value: the name stays, the content keeps moving.
abstract.cn: 变量是一个槽位而不是一个数值：名字不动，内容一直换。

abstract.en: To call something variable is to say its future cannot be read off its present.
abstract.cn: 说某物「可变」，等于说它的未来无法从现状读出。

abstract.en: Every experiment is a bargain: hold most things still so that one thing may move.
abstract.cn: 每个实验都是一笔交易：让大多数东西不动，好让一样东西动起来。

examples.en: Researchers recorded each variable twice a day.
examples.cn: 研究人员每天记录每个变量两次。

examples.en: The results were affected by several variables beyond our control.
examples.cn: 结果受到了几个我们无法控制的可变因素影响。

examples.en: The quality of the soil is highly variable across the farm.
examples.cn: 这片农田的土质差异很大。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威瑞额波」——威（风）瑞（气）额波一波波变来变去：变量

root: 源自拉丁语形容词 varius「斑驳的、多样的」及其动词 variare「改变」，经 variabilis 与古法语 variable 进入英语；同族词有 vary、various、variety、variation。

sensesIntro.en: Variable moves from a symbol in an equation, to a factor in a lab, to weather, temper and costs.
sensesIntro.cn: variable 从方程里的符号，走到实验室的因素，再到天气、脾气与成本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a column of liquid in a thermometer that will not stay at one mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：温度计里的液柱不肯停在同一刻度上。

branches.en: MATHS LINE: the letter that may take any value.
branches.cn: 数学线：可以取任何值的字母。

branches.en: LAB LINE: the factor you watch or control.
branches.cn: 实验线：你观察或控制的因素。

branches.en: CHARACTER LINE: rainfall and tempers that shift.
branches.cn: 性质线：会变的雨量和脾气。

branches.en: MONEY LINE: costs that follow output.
branches.cn: 金钱线：随产量走的成本。

branches.en: CONTRAST: variable is the slot, constant is the fixed number.
branches.cn: 对照线：variable 是槽位，constant 是固定数。

intro.en: Variable is the Latin root vari- plus a suffix meaning capable, then an English-looking vowel.
intro.cn: variable 是拉丁词根 vari- 加上表示「能……的」后缀构成的。

latinIntro.en: The Latin chain is varius, variare and variabilis; all three are attested forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁链条是 varius、variare、variabilis，三者都是可考的实有形式。

items.example: It is the root of variable.

definition_zh: 变体；变种；变异株；异体；不同的
definition_en: a form or version that differs from the standard one, or differing from a standard
core_image: 同一份说明书的两个版本，页边多了几处不同的批注
scene: 同一份说明书在两个城市印出了两种版式。编辑指着南方版说：The southern edition uses a variant of the same logo.
sceneCN: 这里指「变体／略有不同的版本」（第 1 个义项：与标准形式不同的一个版本）；句意为南方版使用了同一标志的一个变体。

pos.zh: 变体；变种；变异株；异体（可数，复数 variants）
不同的；变异的；替代的

derivatives.zh: 变化；使不同
变化；变异；变奏
可变的 / 变量
可变性；变异性
各种各样的
不变的 / 不变量

senses.title: A differing version
senses.definition: a version of something that differs in some details from the standard
senses.definitionCN: 在某些细节上与标准不同的一个版本
senses.example: The southern edition uses a variant of the same logo.
senses.exampleCN: 南方版使用了同一标志的一个变体。
senses.why: Variant treats difference as a countable thing: one standard, and beside it another version.
senses.whyCN: variant 把差异当成可数的东西：有一个标准，旁边另有某个版本。

senses.title: A genetic variant
senses.definition: a version of a gene or DNA sequence that differs from the reference
senses.definitionCN: 与参照序列不同的基因或脱氧核糖核酸序列版本
senses.example: This genetic variant lowers the risk of heart disease.
senses.exampleCN: 这种遗传变异型降低心脏病风险。
senses.why: Genetics applies the general idea of a differing version to a segment of DNA, counted against a reference genome.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学把「不同版本」的一般观念用到一段脱氧核糖核酸上，以参照基因组为基准来计数。

senses.title: A viral variant
senses.definition: a virus lineage that carries a set of mutations distinguishing it from others
senses.definitionCN: 携带一组突变、因而与其他谱系不同的病毒谱系
senses.example: The new variant spreads faster but causes milder illness.
senses.exampleCN: 新变异株传播更快，但致病较轻。
senses.why: Public health needs a countable label for lineages, so the general word becomes the standard term for a mutated virus.
senses.whyCN: 公共卫生需要给谱系一个可数的标签，于是这个一般词成为指变异病毒的标准术语。

senses.title: A spelling variant
senses.definition: an accepted alternative spelling of the same word
senses.definitionCN: 同一个词被接受的另一种拼写
senses.example: The dictionary lists both spellings as variants.
senses.exampleCN: 词典把两种拼写都列为异体。
senses.why: Language tolerates two written forms of one word, and the noun marks them as equal versions rather than errors.
senses.whyCN: 语言容许同一个词有两种书写形式，这个名词把它们标为平等的版本，而非错误。

senses.title: An alternative product version
senses.definition: a model or configuration of a product that differs from the main one
senses.definitionCN: 与主版本不同的产品型号或配置
senses.example: The cheaper variant lacks the heated seats.
senses.exampleCN: 较便宜的版本没有加热座椅。
senses.why: Manufacturers sell one design in several configurations, and each configuration is a variant of the same model.
senses.whyCN: 厂商把同一设计做成多种配置，每种配置都是同一型号的一个变体。

senses.title: A textual variant
senses.definition: a reading in a manuscript or edition that differs from another reading
senses.definitionCN: 手稿或版本中与另一读法不同的文字
senses.example: Editors recorded every variant across the surviving copies.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑记录了现存各本中的每一处异文。
senses.why: Manuscripts of one work drift apart, and scholarship needs a word for each differing reading.
senses.whyCN: 同一作品的手稿会彼此偏离，学术研究需要一个词来指每一种不同的读法。

senses.title: Differing as an adjective
senses.definition: showing variation from a standard form
senses.definitionCN: 表现出与标准形式不同的
senses.example: A variant reading changes the meaning of the line.
senses.exampleCN: 一个不同的读法会改变这一行的意思。
senses.why: As an adjective the word describes the form itself rather than naming a version as a noun.
senses.whyCN: 作形容词时，这个词描述形式本身，而不是把某个版本作为名词命名出来。

senses.title: A nonstandard form
senses.definition: a form used by some speakers but not accepted as the standard
senses.definitionCN: 被部分使用者采用、但未被接受为标准的形式
senses.example: The teacher marked the variant as acceptable but informal.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把这个非标准形式标为可接受但不正式。
senses.why: Once a standard is fixed, everything beside it is called a variant, whether or not it is wrong.
senses.whyCN: 一旦标准被固定，旁边的一切都被称为变体，不论它是否错误。

intro.en: Variant comes from Latin variantem, the present participle of variare 'to change', and entered English through French in the eighteenth century. The genetic and viral senses are modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: variant 来自拉丁 variantem，即 variare「改变」的现在分词，经法语在 18 世纪进入英语。遗传学与病毒学的义项属现代用法。年代均为约数。

items.en: Variare 'to change' has the present participle varians, variant-. English variant is this participle used as adjective and noun.
items.cn: variare「改变」的现在分词是 varians（词干 variant-）。英语 variant 就是这个词形，兼作形容词与名词。

items.en: The verb rests on varius 'varied, various', the same adjective behind variety and various.
items.cn: 这个动词建立在 varius「多样的、不同的」之上，同一形容词也衍生 variety 与 various。

items.en: French variant passed into English in the eighteenth century as a term for a differing form, especially in printing and manuscripts.
items.cn: 法语 variant 在 18 世纪进入英语，指不同的形式，尤用于印刷与手稿。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word was adopted for differing gene sequences and, later, for viral lineages.
items.cn: 20 世纪，这个词被用来指不同的基因序列，后来又指病毒谱系。

items.en: Modern English uses variant as a neutral noun for any alternative version and as an adjective meaning 'differing'.
items.cn: 现代英语中 variant 作中性名词指任何替代版本，也作形容词表示「不同的」。

items.en: Source uncertain (root and first dates): the deeper origin of Latin varius is disputed, and the earliest English use of variant is dated only within the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根与首见年代）：拉丁 varius 的更深来源有争议；variant 在英语中的最早使用只能定在 18 世纪之内。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same vary family that are easily swapped; group two holds general words for alternative versions.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 vary 词族、容易被混用的词；第二组是表示替代版本的一般词。

entries.definition: The fact or degree of changing; variant is a countable version, while variation may be uncountable.
entries.definitionCN: 指变化的事实或程度；variant 是可数的版本，而 variation 可以不可数。

entries.definition: A range of different kinds, or a cultivated plant kind; it does not mean one alternative version.
entries.definitionCN: 指多种不同种类，或栽培品种；不表示某一个替代版本。

entries.definition: A numerical measure of spread, or a formal disagreement; it is not a physical version.
entries.definitionCN: 指离散程度的数值，或正式分歧；不是具体的版本。

entries.definition: A statistical variable; the spelling differs by one letter but the field is mathematics.
entries.definitionCN: 指统计变量；拼写只差一个字母，但所属领域是数学。

entries.definition: Any form of something from a particular point of view; it is broader and needs no standard.
entries.definitionCN: 指从某一角度看某事物的任一形式；范围更广，也不预设标准。

entries.definition: The shape or arrangement of something; it names structure rather than difference from a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 指事物的形状或安排；命名结构，而非与标准的差异。

entries.definition: A genetic lineage within a species; in microbiology it is close to variant but usually implies a cultured stock.
entries.definitionCN: 指物种内的一个遗传谱系；在微生物学中接近 variant，但通常暗示培养的品系。

entries.definition: One published form of a text; a variant is a differing reading, while an edition is the whole printing.
entries.definitionCN: 指文本的一个出版形式；variant 是一处不同读法，edition 是整个印本。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: vari- 'different' + -ant 'the one being': the one that differs.
normal.cn: vari-「不同」+ -ant「处于某种状态的那一个」：不同的那一个。

normal.en: The family runs vary, variation, variable, variability, various.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 vary、variation、variable、variability、various。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the technical senses: genetic variant, new variant, spelling variant.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出专业义：遗传变异型、新变异株、拼写异体。

normal.en: A variant is one countable version; variation is the fact or range of difference.
normal.cn: variant 是一个可数的版本；variation 是差异的事实或范围。

normal.en: In manuscripts, editors list variants; in genetics, databases list variants.
normal.cn: 在手稿研究中，编辑列出异文；在遗传学中，数据库列出变异型。

abstract.en: Picture two keys that open the same door but have different notches.
abstract.cn: 想象两把钥匙能开同一扇门，齿形却不同。

abstract.en: Picture one song released in a radio cut and a longer album cut.
abstract.cn: 想象同一首歌发行了电台版和更长的专辑版。

abstract.en: Picture a map reprinted with one road renamed.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图重印时有一条路改了名。

examples.en: The variant differs from the reference sequence at one position.
examples.cn: 该变异型在参照序列的一个位置上不同。

examples.en: Both variants of the software are still supported.
examples.cn: 该软件的两个版本仍在维护。

examples.en: Historians compare variants of the same letter.
examples.cn: 历史学家比较同一封信的不同文本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维瑞恩特」——同一个东西换了个版本，像同款衣服的另一种颜色 → 变体

root: 拉丁 variare「改变」的现在分词 varians（词干 variant-），出自 varius「多样的」；varius 的更深来源存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one move: a standard is fixed, and beside it a differing version is counted, whether in genes, viruses, spelling, products or manuscripts.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：先有标准，旁边再数出一个不同的版本，可用于基因、病毒、拼写、产品或手稿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two printings of one document with small differences in the margin.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一份文件的两个印本，页边有细小差别。

branches.en: VERSION AND NONSTANDARD FORM: a neutral different version, and one accepted only informally.
branches.cn: 版本与非标准形式：一个是中性的不同版本，一个只在非正式场合被接受。

branches.en: GENES AND VIRUSES: the countable version becomes a DNA sequence or a viral lineage.
branches.cn: 基因与病毒：可数的版本变成一段脱氧核糖核酸序列或一个病毒谱系。

branches.en: WORDS AND TEXTS: spelling and manuscript readings are catalogued as variants.
branches.cn: 文字与文本：拼写与手稿读法被编目为异文。

branches.en: PRODUCTS: one design sold in several configurations.
branches.cn: 产品：同一设计以多种配置出售。

branches.en: ADJECTIVE: the word describes the differing form itself.
branches.cn: 形容词：这个词直接描述那个不同的形式。

intro.en: Variant is a Latin present participle in form: vari- supplies the meaning 'different' and -ant marks the thing that differs.
intro.cn: variant 在形式上是拉丁现在分词：vari- 提供「不同」的意思，-ant 标记那个不同的事物。

latinIntro.en: The same Latin verb variare underlies variation, variable and vary; variant is its participial branch.
latinIntro.cn: 同一拉丁动词 variare 支撑 variation、variable 与 vary；variant 是它的分词分支。

items.structure: Latin varius (varied, different) as a root
items.example: The root opens various and variety.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在 various 与 variety 开头。

items.meaning: the one that is or does
items.meaningCN: 处于某状态或做某事的那一个
items.example: Variant marks the version that differs.
items.exampleCN: variant 标记那个不同的版本。

items.example: The two copies vary in one line.
items.exampleCN: 两个本子在一行上不同。

items.example: Variation across the range is wide.
items.exampleCN: 整个范围内的差异很大。

items.example: The variable affects the final score.
items.exampleCN: 这个变量影响最终得分。

items.example: The variance between samples was small.
One variant lacks the final paragraph.
items.exampleCN: 有一个版本缺少最后一段。

items.meaning: not changing; a quantity that stays fixed
items.example: The ratio is invariant under rotation.
items.exampleCN: 这个比值在旋转下不变。

latinEntries.structure: variare, vario, variavi, variatum (verb, first conjugation)

definition_zh: 变化；变动；差异；变体、变奏；变异
definition_en: a change in amount, level or form, or a different version of something
core_image: 同一首歌被唱了五遍，每一遍的音高都略有不同
scene: 气象站的记录本上，同一个月的降雨量每年都不一样。There is a wide variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
sceneCN: 这里 variation 是「差异、变化幅度」（第 2 个义项：程度上的不同）；句意为沙漠里昼夜温差很大。同一首歌每遍音高略异，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 名词：变化、变动、差异；变体、变奏；变异

collocations.zh: 主题变奏、略加改动的版本

derivatives.zh: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是本词的动词形式
名词或形容词，义为「变体、变种」
形容词，义为「多样的、各不相同的」
名词，义为「可变性、波动幅度」
形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」

senses.title: The act of changing
senses.titleCN: 变化：某物在改变的过程
senses.definition: the act or process of changing
senses.definitionCN: 正在改变的动作或过程
senses.example: Careful measurement showed a slight variation in pressure overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 仔细测量显示夜间气压有细微变化。
senses.why: Latin variare means to change, and -atio names the act; the word is the process itself.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 variare 意为改变，-atio 命名这一行为；这个词就是过程本身。

senses.title: A difference in amount
senses.definition: a difference in amount, level or degree between things
senses.definitionCN: 事物之间在数量、水平或程度上的不同
senses.example: There is a wide variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠里昼夜温差很大。
senses.why: Once difference is measured, the word shifts from process to size: the amount of difference.
senses.whyCN: 差异一旦被测量，这个词就从过程变成幅度：差了多少。

senses.title: A changed version
senses.definition: a thing that differs slightly from another of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 与同类事物略有不同的版本
senses.example: The chef offered a vegetarian variation of the same dish.
senses.exampleCN: 厨师给同一道菜提供了素食版本。
senses.why: The same base appears in a new shape; the family resemblance stays visible.
senses.whyCN: 同一个底子换了一个形状出现，家族的相似仍然看得见。

senses.title: A musical form
senses.titleCN: 变奏：把一个主题反复改写
senses.definition: a repeated melody altered in rhythm, key or harmony
senses.definitionCN: 把一段旋律在节奏、调性或和声上反复改写
senses.example: The pianist played a set of variations on a folk tune.
senses.exampleCN: 钢琴家演奏了一组民谣主题变奏。
senses.why: Music makes the idea audible: one theme, many dresses.
senses.whyCN: 音乐让这个概念可以被听见：同一个主题，换很多件衣服。

senses.title: Biological difference
senses.titleCN: 变异：同种生物个体间的差别
senses.definition: differences between individuals of the same species, often inherited
senses.definitionCN: 同种生物个体之间的差别，常由遗传造成
senses.example: Genetic variation is what allows a population to adapt.
senses.exampleCN: 遗传变异使得一个种群能够适应环境。
senses.why: Living things copy themselves imperfectly, so each generation carries small differences that selection can use.
senses.whyCN: 生物复制自身时并不完美，于是每一代都带着细微差别，供自然选择使用。

intro.en: Variation is the Latin verb variare plus the noun ending -atio, a way of naming a process.
intro.cn: variation 是拉丁动词 variare 加名词词尾 -atio，用来给一个过程命名。

items.en: The verb variare meant to make different or to shift between forms.
items.cn: 动词 variare 意为使不同，或在各形式之间变换。

items.en: The noun variatio named the act of changing, with the ending -atio for an action.
items.cn: 名词 variatio 指改变的行为，词尾 -atio 表示动作。

items.en: Old French passed on variacion, still meaning a change or difference.
items.cn: 古法语传下 variacion，仍指变化或差异。

items.en: English took variation in the fourteenth century for changes in weather, price and form.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 variation，用于天气、价格与形式的变化。

items.en: Modern usage adds music and biology, giving the word a technical life beside its everyday one.
items.cn: 现代用法增添了音乐与生物学，使这个词在日常生活之外又有了术语的生命。

note.en: The look-alike group is the vari- family; the near-meaning group gathers words for difference and change.
note.cn: 形近组是 vari- 家族；近义组收表示差异与变化的词。

entries.definition: The verb, to differ or change by degrees.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「变化、不同」，是它的动词形式。

entries.definition: A form that differs from the standard one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「变体」，与标准形式不同。

entries.definition: A range of kinds, rather than one change.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性、种类」，不是单次变化。

entries.definition: Something that is able to change.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「可变的、变量」。

entries.definition: The plain noun for becoming different.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「变化」，最普通的说法。

entries.definition: Rising and falling again and again, like a level.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「波动」，反复起落。

entries.definition: The gap between two things, without motion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「差别」，不含运动感。

entries.definition: One form of something that exists in several forms.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「版本」，几个形式中的一个。

normalIntro.en: The hooks lean on the vari- family and on phrases like variation on a theme.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子依靠 vari- 词族与 variation on a theme 这类搭配。

normal.en: Vary is the verb, variation is the change itself.
normal.cn: vary 是动词，variation 是变化本身。

normal.en: A variation on a theme is the same tune in new clothes.
normal.cn: variation on a theme 就是同一段旋律换了衣服。

normal.en: Genetic variation is why siblings are not identical.
normal.cn: 遗传变异是兄弟姐妹不完全相同的原因。

normal.en: Seasonal variation explains why prices move with the calendar.
normal.cn: 季节变化解释了价格为何跟着日历走。

normal.en: A wide variation means the numbers are far apart.
normal.cn: wide variation 指数字彼此差距很大。

abstract.en: Variation is difference with a memory: it tells you what the same thing looks like elsewhere.
abstract.cn: 变化是一种带记忆的差别：它告诉你同一事物在别处长什么样。

abstract.en: One process, several versions, many notes: the word carries all three without changing shape.
abstract.cn: 一个过程、几个版本、许多音符：这个词不变形就能承载三者。

abstract.en: Without variation there is no selection; difference is what time can work on.
abstract.cn: 没有差异就没有选择；时间能作用的正是差别。

examples.en: There is a wide variation in rainfall across the region.
examples.cn: 这个地区的降雨量差异很大。

examples.en: The design is a variation on a chair she made last year.
